info.prompt: Dynamic action shot of a Heist in progress—a thief's silhouette lunges across the board as their energy meter drains from emerald to crimson, vault points spiraling into their avatar while rival players' Headhunter abilities manifest as jagged gold projectiles frozen mid-block attempt, all backlit by the unstable flicker of frenzy mode's dual-layer UI where PRIME's ivory sanctuary elements fracture into obsidian shards revealing the underlying bio-mechanical grid.
